name: com.mochoindiestudio.signals
description: A tiny, engine-light global signal channel shared by the MIS Dialog System, MIS Quest System and MIS Inventory System packages. One string-keyed Report / Subscribe bus (event id + optional payload + amount) so those packages can integrate through a game without referencing each other's assemblies. The runtime core has no UnityEngine dependency; an optional Authoring assembly adds a [SignalId] attribute and a searchable id picker for editor fields.
